notes.title: 1.01 Update
notes.content:

Thank you for playing The Sealed Ampoule.

Based on your feedback, we've updated the build to 1.01.

[*] Fixed the issue that the Fullscreen setting not saved
[*] Added mouse control (Confirm / Cancel
[*] Improved CPU/GPU performance
[*] Fixed the issue about the key item in the monster house
[/list]
